test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**disrupted**" means interrupted or caused difficulties, which fits the context of the passage discussing the interruptions to children's speech therapy due to pandemic restrictions.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Pandemic restrictions vary by state, county and school district, but I spoke with parents in California, New York, Massachusetts, Washington, New Jersey, Iowa and Maryland, who said their children’s speech therapy has been disrupted__ first by the loss of in-person therapy and then by masking requirements, in places that have them.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Disrupted**: Interrupted or caused difficulties** (appropriate in context of therapy being interrupted).**
 
• **Regulated**: Controlled or maintained according to a set of rules (not fitting here).
 
• **Measured**: Assessed or calculated (not suitable for discussing interruptions).
 
• **Normalised**: Brought to a standard or regular condition (opposite of what is needed here).
